title: No shared tool-argument decoder; a dozen drifting helpers and inline assertions
note: Helpers confirmed (session_tools.go:1791,1799; find.go:280,294,309; shell.go:486,493; jobs.go:2244,2279,2308,2556,2607). Corrections: only 7 inline .(float64) sites outside helpers (shell.go:203,207,211,866,872; model_list.go:21,24); the other 2 are inside optionalIntArg/optionalWholeIntArg. All 12 fmt.Sprint(args[key]) sites confirmed. Some strictness differences are deliberate: watchStringArg's comment (jobs.go:2300ish) says coercion would build a watch on the wrong source, and watchIntArg documents NaN/overflow handling. Registry schema validation normally gates types first, so model-visible drift is smaller than claimed ('no product reason' overstated). Still real duplication; three []any-of-strings loops are the cleanest win.
revised_fix_plan: Start with the safe, behavior-preserving consolidation: one generic string-list helper replacing stringArrayArg/jobStatusArrayArg/jobTypeArrayArg, and one strict optional string/bool/whole-int set in one file (move optionalStringArg/optionalBoolArg/optionalWholeIntArg out of session_tools_find.go; make watchStringArg/watchIntArg call them where messages permit). Leave the lenient shell/model_list clamps alone unless Jesse approves an accept/reject change; they are intentional. Replace fmt.Sprint(args[k]) with stringArg only where the schema marks the field required (characterization test first for absent key). Do not add a new package; keep it in agent/. Characterization tests for 1.5, '3', null, negative per tool before migrating.

title: Dead functions retained under nolint:unused, an unused constant, and tests that pin them
note: Verified. watchSendArg (jobs.go:2577) and isEmptyWatchSend (2601) have no non-test callers repo-wide; job_watch rejects send at jobs.go:2329. clearDescendantReceiverWatchByID (370) has only 7 test hits in 4 files; projectJobRecord (2674) only 2 test hits; jobKindAgent (36) appears only in its declaration and an old plan doc. Tests that call these are in session_tools_jobs_cov_test.go:96-116, covtest2_test.go:534-596, and tagged evenerfuzz files (seed100_range_a/d/more, jobs_seed100_fuzz_test.go:241, contract_program_fuzz_test.go:138). Because the tagged files only compile under -tags evenerfuzz, deletion must be checked with a tagged vet/compile (make lint tagged compile floors) or the build will break silently under default vet.
revised_fix_plan: Delete the functions, constant, and the tests calling them, including edits to the evenerfuzz-tagged files; run go vet -tags evenerfuzz ./agent to confirm tagged compile. Drop `_ = deps` and the unused param in registerJobToolsWithRegistrar (combine with finding 3).

title: Test-only injection seams compiled into production code
note: worktreeSeams part confirmed: session_tools_worktree.go:39 process-global sync.Map keyed by *Session; only Load in prod (line 42), Store only at session_tools_worktree_test.go:46; installWorktreeSeams used in 4 test files. cfg.testOnly (session_config.go:296) already exists and is the sanctioned home, so moving it there is natural. Not confirmed: execToolCheckpoint is already a cfg.testOnly field (session_config.go:501), i.e. already the right pattern, and is called 5 times, not 6 (session_tools.go:867,892,914,966,973); it should not be in this finding. jobToolRegistrar (jobs.go:76) is a one-method single-impl interface, but deps.registerTool already exists as a toolDeps seam used by session_tool_registry.go:513 and core_exact/shell fuzz tests, and the fault-injection test uses a Nth-registration-fails fake (jobs_seed100_fuzz_test.go:214), which a conflicting pre-registered name does not trivially replicate.
revised_fix_plan: (a) Move worktreeTestSeams to a field on cfg.testOnly and delete the sync.Map; update installWorktreeSeams in the 4 test files. (b) Replace jobToolRegistrar/jobToolRegisterFunc with a plain `register func(tool.RegisteredTool) error` parameter, using the same `register := reg.Register; if deps.registerTool != nil {...}` pattern already at session_tool_registry.go:508-514; adapt seed100Registrar in the tagged fuzz test. Skip execToolCheckpoint.

title: Registration boilerplate: false `_ = ctx; _ = env`, swallowed Register errors, repeated Limit literals
note: Confirmed: jobs.go:116-120 has `_ = ctx; _ = env` then uses ctx on the next line; 17 `_ = env` lines across 9 files; 14 prod `_ = reg.Register(` (notes 4, shell 2, web 2, ask/communicate/compact/goal/task/worktree 1 each). Limit literal with jobToolResultDefaultMaxChar appears 5 times (jobs.go:86,97,108,118 and session_tools.go:123), not 6; delegate_send uses delegateReportWholeMaxChars. Swallowed errors are a real but latent risk (duplicate names only at startup). Propagating errors changes registerCoreTools signatures; modest.
revised_fix_plan: Use `_` for unused Exec params, drop the `_ = x` lines, and hoist a jobToolLimit var for the 5 literals. Propagating Register errors is a small separate change: only do it for the register*Tools that already sit next to code returning errors (registry.go:500-514), do not table-ize the job registrations (each closure differs).

title: Tool-name mapping helpers duplicated as pure funcs and Session wrappers in the Session grab-bag file
note: Facts check out (session_tools.go:677-770) but this is not duplication: Session methods are thin snapshot wrappers and the pure funcs are called directly only from execTool (787-788) and the wrappers; no logic is repeated. The lock-order differences (providerVisibleToolNames reads s.profile under a held s.mu; providerVisibleToolName locks via currentProfile) are real constraints explained at lines 684-699, not accidental drift. Moving to provider.Profile with an inverse-map cache is new mechanism for a linear scan over a small map, contrary to YAGNI. canonicalToolName is called per stream event (session_stream.go:443-471), but maps are tiny.
revised_fix_plan: No action beyond optionally moving the five helpers out of session_tools.go with finding 7. Do not move into provider.Profile.

title: execTool is a 273-line function with three copies of the cancelled tool-end emission
note: execTool spans session_tools.go:773-1046 (273 lines) and does interleave repair, pre-hooks, event bracket, dispatch, escalation, chunking, post-hooks. 'Three copies' is overstated: emitCanceledEnd closure (used twice, ~928, ~958) plus one inline copy at 972-984 that differs deliberately because the response side-effects lock is already held there (the closure takes it) and uses call.Name vs res.ToolName. Error ExecResult literal appears 3 times (818, ~834, ~845) plus a variant with ToolState in post-hooks. Extraction is reasonable but concurrency ordering makes it riskier than the finding implies.
revised_fix_plan: Pure extraction only: errorResult(call,msg) helper; split out runPreHooks (returns deny/updated-input) and runPostHooks; leave the lock-ordered emit/close block in execTool and reduce the inline cancelled-end to a shared emitToolEnd(locked bool) variant. Guard with the existing checkpoint tests (session_skill_delivery_test.go, session_communicate_test.go); no behavior change, no reordering.

title: session_tools.go mixes dispatch, vision side channel, delegate create, tool-def cache and task store
note: Verified: file is 1822 lines; stable delegate create 97-250, vision side channel 295-675, tool def cache 1422-1680, task/goal store accessors 1727-1790. Correction: stableDelegateSendTool (line 142) is also here, so delegate send/create live in session_tools.go while status/stop/watch live in jobs.go. docs/product/subsystems.md:S14 (row at ~188) links session_tools.go as 'Tool dispatch' and must be updated on move. Pure moves, no logic change.
revised_fix_plan: As proposed (session_tools_vision.go, session_tools_delegate.go incl. delegate_send, session_tool_definitions.go, task store accessors); also move the five tool-name helpers and stringArg/optionalIntArg per finding 1. Update subsystems.md S14 link list in the same change.

title: Output-limit enforcement and max-chars lookup implemented three times
note: Verified: shellToolResultMaxChars (shell.go:523) and jobToolResultMaxChars (jobs.go:2756) are identical apart from tool name and constants (both min 800); enforceShellToolJSONLimit (shell.go:508) vs enforceJobToolJSONLimits (jobs.go:2770) differ in a real drift: the shell override omits Strategy (MaxChars only) while the job version preserves registered.Limit.Strategy. jobListOutputMaxChars (jobs.go:2747) is unclamped. All three enforce* called from session_init.go:1762-1764.
revised_fix_plan: One minJSONLimit(reg,name,default) and one enforceMinJSONLimits(reg,names) preserving Strategy (check OverrideLimits merge semantics first to confirm shell's dropped Strategy is not relied on); keep model_list's byte-budget logic. Table test over nil/missing/0/500/5000 plus strategy preservation.

title: Ignored maxChars params and six-fold progressive-drop stanza in result marshaling
note: Verified: `_ = maxChars` at jobs.go:1233,1818,1952,1989,1994 (and the stop function) while callers thread maxChars (e.g. jobs.go:236-250). marshalStableDelegateCreateResult (session_tools.go:215-250) has six marshalBoundedJSONWithFit stanzas with an inline comment naming a test. marshalBoundedJSON error says 'job tool JSON output' (jobs.go:2728) though session_tools.go:248 uses it for delegate.
revised_fix_plan: Remove the unused param from the five marshal/stop functions and callers; replace the ladder with a slice of `func(*stableDelegateCreateResult)` drop steps in the same order (order is pinned by the minimum-limit delegate test). Rename the error text to 'tool JSON output'.

title: Path-containment helper implemented 8+ times, two identical in one file
note: In-file duplication confirmed: pathEqualOrUnder(candidate,target) (worktree.go:1180) and pathWithin(path,dir) (1685) are semantically identical (equality short-circuit is redundant since Rel returns '.'); pathEqualOrUnder has 3 callers (1019,1035,1069), pathWithin 1. Repo-wide 'identical copies' is not true: session_scratch.go:213 rejects empty root and cleans, execenv/local.go:3491 resolves symlinks and uses string prefix, project_resolver.go:302 optionally resolves symlinks, fspaths/paths.go:124 requires pre-cleaned input, fuzzregistry uses registryRel. relPathUnderManagedDir (1789) deliberately returns the rel and rejects '.', so is not a copy. A shared helper would need to preserve these differences.
revised_fix_plan: Merge pathEqualOrUnder into pathWithin in this file only (rename callers; add a table test for equal/child/sibling-prefix/..). Drop the repo-wide consolidation unless Jesse wants it as a separate effort that accounts for symlink and empty-root semantics.

title: session_tools_jobs.go (2888 lines, 99 funcs) mixes six tools' concerns; 'stable' prefix is history
note: Verified: 2888 lines, 99 funcs; stable-prefixed identifiers: 110 case-insensitive 'stable' lines across the slice (54 in jobs.go), more than the 90 claimed. Mirror DTO converters at jobs.go:1798-1815 are straight field copies (delegateWorktreeToolResultFrom, delegateSandboxToolResultFrom). Splitting is safe as pure moves.
revised_fix_plan: Split per tool as proposed in one pure-move commit; do the stableDelegate* rename in a separate mechanical commit. Defer the mirror-DTO removal; verify first that state JSON shapes are consumed by the TS client (appwire) before touching them.

title: session_tools_worktree.go (3798 lines) with a 391-line worktreeRemove and ordinally named prune sweeps
note: Verified: worktreeRemove 2387-2778 (391 lines), 97 funcs, 123 'spec §' lines in worktree.go (132 slice-wide plausible), worktreePruneSweep1/2/3 at 3188/3555/3709, and the duplicate `"merge check failed: " + dErr.Error()` at 3163 and 3170. Keep spec § references where the spec file is cited, or replace them with invariants during the split; put the evergreen step table into docs/product (S13 row) rather than developing-evener/worktrees.md.

title: History and review-round narration in comments (49 hits)
note: Counts verified: 49 hits for roborev or #NNN across non-test files, but only 8 are roborev; the rest are issue-number pointers (e.g. issue #4218, #655, #4671) that locate the regression or contract, which is not the same as narration. Round narration confirmed: ask.go:223,247,599,812,826,850; jobs.go:1768,1792; worktree.go:667,686 ('#4621 round 15'); session_tools.go:224 names a test. The claim of a 'repo convention' is not backed by a repo doc (I found none under docs/developing-evener); it is Jesse's global preference.
revised_fix_plan: Rewrite the roborev/round/test-name comments (about 15 sites) to state the invariant. Leave plain issue-number references unless the surrounding sentence is only the reference. Fold into the file moves of findings 7/11/12 to avoid extra churn.

title: read_transcript argument handling spread over five overlapping functions
note: Overlap is real: normalizeRetainedReadArgs (repair.go:379, about 80 lines), normalizeRetainedReadArgsForValidation (446), isNeutralJobFormat re-judged in retainedReadIncompatibleFields (transcript.go:450), and two parse paths reading offset_bytes via optionalIntArg (transcript.go:434,854). But the neutral-default rules are subtle per-ref-kind and pinned by repair-telemetry tests; the proposed generic field table (name, kind, predicate, allowed refs) is a new mechanism that may be more complex than the five functions. Depends on finding 1.
revised_fix_plan: Do not build the table. After finding 1, switch the two offset_bytes reads to the shared strict int helper and leave normalization alone, unless a concrete bug shows up.

title: Coverage-padding and 'seed100' test families exercising dead or pass-through code
note: Verified: 87 test files / 39,083 lines in the glob for 17,963 prod lines; tests discard results (session_tools_jobs_seed100_range_d_test.go:55-58 `_, _ = watchSendArg(args)`; jobs_seed100_fuzz_test.go:241) and job_watch_covtest2_test.go:898-922 tests only the jobToolRegisterFunc adapter. Corrections: the seed100 files for jobs are small (31-134 lines each, about 430 lines total, plus 280 in jobs_seed100_fuzz_test.go) and all are behind //go:build evenerfuzz, so they do not run in default tests. The 'cov'/'covtest2' files (448 and 1540 lines for jobs) are default-build and do carry real assertions mixed with padding. The -1500 to -3000 LOC estimate is unsupported by the cited files; identifiable removable test code is closer to 300-600 lines.
revised_fix_plan: Delete tests for removed code as part of findings 2 and 3 (about 150-300 lines). Defer a broader coverage-padding purge until per-file review of the covtest/cov files against CI coverage; do not commit to a LOC target.
